requirements.evidence: All four endpoints, the JWT/middleware scope rules, the pairing command and CORS are present: routes/api.php:9-24, app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:21-101, app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:19-84, app/Http/Middleware/TotemCors.php:17-52. Two edge cases are wrong: bootstrap/app.php:38 does not actually stop TrimStrings from cleaning api payloads (breaking the padded-code 400 contract and tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:77), and app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:21 accepts a trailing newline because `$` is not end-of-string (a 7-byte code gets 401 instead of 400).

The pairing transaction is a new domain write implemented directly in the controller (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:30`; the command also writes directly), whereas the project convention routes domain writes through `app/Actions/*`.

Minor duplication: the same preset queue-id pluck/map appears in `app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:56` and `app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:58`.

readability.evidence: Clear names and small focused methods throughout (e.g. `app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemApiController.php:13-50`, `app/Context/TotemContext.php:17-22`); controllers read top-to-bottom, docs describe the implemented behavior, and there is no dead/debug code or inconsistent style.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: schema/factories/models, the four endpoints, middleware/CORS, config/env/phpunit, routes, tests, and the three required docs (plus CHANGELOG/business-rules synchronization and the optional `TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN` used by CORS). No unrelated refactors or features were added.

issues.explanation: `$middleware->trimStrings([...])` takes field names to exempt, not a request predicate, so the closure is never used as a skip condition; ` 123456 ` is still trimmed to a valid code, the explicit `invalid_code_format` requirement is violated and `tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:77` fails. Use `TrimStrings::skipWhen(fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*'))` (or validate the raw payload) instead.

The pattern `/^[0-9]{6}$/` lets a trailing newline match because PCRE `$` also matches before a final newline, so `"123456\n"` passes format validation and returns `invalid_pairing_code` (401) instead of the required 400; anchor with `\z` or the `D` modifier.

The pairing use case (lock preset, consume code, create the totem) is a domain write implemented in the controller (and the command writes directly too), while the project convention requires one `app/Actions/*` class per domain use case.

The per-preset appearance overrides and the `labels_i18n.description` fallback are implemented but never exercised; `tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:229` only checks the default visual/description path.
The preset queue-id pluck/map is duplicated in `app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:58`; a small `TotemPreset::queueIds()` method would keep the scope definition in one place.

review.summary: The change implements the totem BFF end to end: schema/models/factories, pairing command and auth endpoint, HS256 JWT with middleware scope intersection, the three authenticated endpoints, CORS, throttling, tests and the required docs. The main blocker is the `trimStrings` configuration, which does not actually exempt `api/*` payloads from trimming and therefore breaks the explicit invalid-format contract and its test; there is also a narrow regex edge case (trailing newline) and the pairing write bypasses the project's Actions convention. With those fixed (the first is a one-line change to `TrimStrings::skipWhen`), this would be close to approvable.
